mapper.select: OFFSET (#{pageCnt} * (#{pageNo} - 1)) ROWS FETCH FIRST #{pageCnt} ROWS ONLY
mapper.sql:
SELECT /* kh.com.copilot.app.csm.dao.MenuMgtDao.selectListMenuAll */ M.MENU_ID AS "menuId" , M.MENU_LEV AS "menuLev" , M.PARENT_MENU_ID AS "parentMenuId" , M.MENU_ENG_NAME AS "menuEngName" , M.MENU_URL AS "menuUrl" , M.ORDER_SEQ AS "orderSeq" , M.APPROVAL_YN AS "approvalYn" , M.USE_YN AS "useYn" , M.BRANCH_AUTH AS "branchAuth" , COUNT(1) OVER() AS "totalCnt" FROM (SELECT A.MENU_ID , A.MENU_LEV , A.PARENT_MENU_ID , A.MENU_ENG_NAME , A.MENU_URL , A.ORDER_SEQ , A.APPROVAL_YN , A.USE_YN , A.BRANCH_AUTH FROM (SELECT MENU_ID , LEVEL AS MENU_LEV , PARENT_MENU_ID , MENU_ENG_NAME , MENU_URL , ORDER_SEQ , APPROVAL_YN , USE_YN , BRANCH_AUTH FROM ${schema}.TSCSM0001 WHERE OPER_GROUP_CD = #{operGroupCd} START WITH PARENT_MENU_ID = 'M' CONNECT BY PRIOR MENU_ID = PARENT_MENU_ID ORDER SIBLINGS BY ORDER_SEQ) A UNION ALL SELECT AA.MENU_ID , 9 AS MENU_LEV , AA.PARENT_MENU_ID , AA.MENU_ENG_NAME , AA.MENU_URL , AA.ORDER_SEQ , AA.APPROVAL_YN , AA.USE_YN , AA.BRANCH_AUTH FROM ${schema}.TSCSM0001 AA WHERE AA.OPER_GROUP_CD = #{operGroupCd} AND AA.PARENT_MENU_ID = 'H' ) M WHERE 1=1
AND M.MENU_ID LIKE #{menuId}||'%'
AND M.MENU_ENG_NAME LIKE '%'||#{menuEngName}||'%'
AND M.MENU_ID LIKE #{menu2Lev}||'%'
AND M.MENU_ID LIKE #{menu1Lev}||'%'
AND M.MENU_LEV = #{menuLev}
AND M.USE_YN = #{useYn}
mapper.select: SELECT /* kh.com.copilot.app.csm.dao.MenuMgtDao.selectListMenuCombo */ MENU_ID AS "menuId" , MENU_ENG_NAME AS "menuName" FROM ${schema}.TSCSM0001 WHERE OPER_GROUP_CD = #{operGroupCd} ORDER BY ORDER_SEQ ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT /* kh.com.copilot.app.csm.dao.MenuMgtDao.insertMenu */ INTO ${schema}.TSCSM0001 ( OPER_GROUP_CD , MENU_ID , PARENT_MENU_ID , MENU_ENG_NAME , MENU_URL , ORDER_SEQ , APPROVAL_YN , USE_YN , BRANCH_AUTH , SYS_CREATE_YMS , SYS_CREATE_UNO) VALUES ( #{operGroupCd} , CASE WHEN #{menuLev}='1' THEN (SELECT 'M'||LPAD(NVL(MAX(SUBSTR(MENU_ID,2)),'00')+1,2,'0') FROM ${schema}.TSCSM0002 WHERE OPER_GROUP_CD = #{operGroupCd} AND PARENT_MENU_ID = 'M') WHEN #{menuLev}='2' THEN (SELECT #{menu1Lev}||LPAD(NVL(MAX(SUBSTR(MENU_ID,4)),'00')+1,2,'0') FROM ${schema}.TSCSM0001 WHERE OPER_GROUP_CD = #{operGroupCd} AND PARENT_MENU_ID = #{menu1Lev}) WHEN #{menuLev}='3' THEN (SELECT #{menu2Lev}||LPAD(NVL(MAX(SUBSTR(MENU_ID,6)),'00')+1,2,'0') FROM ${schema}.TSCSM0001 WHERE OPER_GROUP_CD = #{operGroupCd} AND PARENT_MENU_ID = #{menu2Lev}) WHEN #{menuLev}='9' THEN (SELECT 'H'||LPAD(NVL(MAX(SUBSTR(MENU_ID,2)),'000000')+1,6,'0') FROM ${schema}.TSCSM0001 WHERE OPER_GROUP_CD = #{operGroupCd} AND PARENT_MENU_ID = 'H') /* HIDDEN 메뉴는 H000000 부터 채번 */ END , CASE WHEN #{menuLev}='1' THEN 'M' WHEN #{menuLev}='2' THEN #{menu1Lev} WHEN #{menuLev}='3' THEN #{menu2Lev} WHEN #{menuLev}='9' THEN 'H' END , #{menuEngName} , #{menuUrl} , #{orderSeq} , #{approvalYn} , #{useYn} , #{branchAuth} , CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , #{sysLastUno})
